let ck = "sessionid=" + (String(cookie.getKey("fanqienovel.com", "sessionid")) ? String(cookie.getKey("fanqienovel.com", "sessionid")) : (source.getLoginInfoMap() || {})['手动登录Token'])

getShelf = () => {
let book_shelf_url = 'https://fanqienovel.com/reading/bookapi/bookshelf/info/v:version/?aid=1967&iid=0&version_code=69132&update_version_code=69132'
let book_shelf_info = JSON.parse(java.ajax(book_shelf_url + ', ' + JSON.stringify({
  headers: {
    'Cookie': ck
  }
})))

let list = [];
if (book_shelf_info.data != null && book_shelf_info.data.book_shelf_info) {
    let data = book_shelf_info.data.book_shelf_info;
    if (data != null) {
        let requestData = { books: [] };
        for (let i in data) {
            requestData["books"].push({
                book_id: data[i]["book_id"],
                item_id: "0",
            });
        }
        let booksData = java.ajax(
            'https://fanqienovel.com/api/bookshelf/multidetail,{method: "post",body: ' +
                JSON.stringify(requestData) +
                "}"
        );
        let books = JSON.parse(booksData).data.detail_list;
        for (let i in books) {
            let d = books[i];
            list.push({
                src: d,
                book_name: d.book_name,
                thumb_url: replaceCover(d.thumb_url),
                abstract: d.abstract,
                book_id: d.book_id,
            });
        }
    }
}
return {book_info: list}
}

function getByGroupName(name) {
  let book_shelf_url = 'https://fanqienovel.com/reading/bookapi/bookshelf/info/v:version/?aid=1967&iid=0&version_code=69132&update_version_code=69132'

  let book_shelf_info = JSON.parse(java.ajax(book_shelf_url + ', ' + JSON.stringify({
    headers: {
      'Cookie': ck,
    }
  })))
  let group_bookids = {}
  // java.log(
  book_shelf_info.data.book_shelf_info.forEach(i => {
    let groupName = i.group_name ? i.group_name : ""
    if (!group_bookids[groupName]) group_bookids[groupName] = []
    group_bookids[groupName].push(i.book_id)
  })
  // java.log(JSON.stringify(group_bookids[""]))
  // java.log(decodeURIComponent(name))
  if (!group_bookids[decodeURIComponent(name)]) return {data: []}
  //java.log("awa")
  let book_ids = splitArray(group_bookids[decodeURIComponent(name)], 100)
  let urls = []

  book_ids.forEach(i => {
    urls.push(xGorgon("multi-detail", "book_id=" + i.join(","), null, ck))
  })
  
  res = java.ajaxAll(urls)
res1 = JSON.stringify(res).match(/\d{19}/g)
let res2 = ["{{木里}}/api/index.php?api=content&book_id=" + res1.join(',')];



    
let resp = {book_info: []}
res2.forEach(r => {
  resp.book_info = resp.book_info.concat(JSON.parse(java.ajax(r)).data)
})
return resp.book_info[0]
//java.log(JSON.stringify(result))
}

function getByTabIndex(index) {
  let url = xGorgon(
	  "bookmall/tab",
    "version_name=6.9.1.32&device_id=1024&device_type=114514&iid=2048",
	  null,
	  ck
  )
  let all = JSON.parse(java.ajax(url))
  let tab = all.data.tab_item[0].cell_data[index]
  // java.log(JSON.stringify(tab))
  tab = tab.cell_data
  if (!tab) tab = []
  let bookList = []
  for (let i of tab) {
    if (!i.book_data) {
      let nexttab = i.cell_data || []
      nexttab
        .filter(i => i.show_type === 125)
        .forEach(i => bookList = bookList.concat(i.book_data || []))
    } else {
      bookList = bookList.concat(i.book_data)
    }
    // java.log(JSON.stringify(i.book_data))
  }
  return { book_info: bookList }
}

if (baseUrl.includes("bookshelf")) result = getShelf("bookshelf/info")

else {

    result = getByGroupName(w[w.length - 1])
  } else if (baseUrl.includes("tab")) {
    result = getByTabIndex(parseInt(w[w.length - 1]))
  } else result = JSON.parse(result)
}
